title: Did not fit Ziplock gallon bags
text: Did not fit Ziplock gallon bags. Like many others, I've been wanting to join the band wagon and get a set of nice wooden boxes to hold my Ziplock bags so I could ditch the store boxes and have a more put together look in my kitchen. Well, this set was perfect, that is, until I tried putting my gallon Ziplock bags inside. The box was ever so slightly too short - causing the bags to rise with an unsightly hump in the middle and not lay flat enough to clear the top of the drawer. Well, crap. Back to the drawing board. My daughter saw them sitting on my counter one day and asked if she could have them. Ended up that they worked for her (she uses a different brand of baggies). I'm too set in my ways with the Ziplock brand and am not going to switch brands just so I can use a certain product to store them. Bottom line, they are a nice set of storage boxes, well made, sturdy.. just be sure to take all measurements into account before ordering and know that, despite the given measurements, the gallon box is TOO SMALL for Ziplock brand gallon bags.
